notes.title: Sound of the Space Rainbow
notes.content:
First build did not have sound and it was a bit monochrome.
Now everything is colored proceduraly :)

notes.title: Plan for 2025
notes.content:
Demo for next fest!
Game is to be released not to long after the next fest, probably Q2 or Q3, will see.
The demo will be the primary deciding factor of the direction for the future of the project, as this is the first release I am working on and have no idea how good, bad, stupid, ugly it will go.
Final release could be completely different for all I know, and fall for the usual well known production monster that me call scope creep ;(.

So far the plan is a simple scope, in style of asteroids, diep.io, survivors roguelike with potentially some spaceship customization (hopefully), we will see :)
